SELECT 
    cv.chassisregistry,
    (1 - (cv.brakepadwearpercent + cv.trackwearpercent) / 200.0) * (cv.vehiclespeedkmh / 50.0) * (ef.engineloadpercent / 100.0) AS vpc,
    cv.brakefluidlevelpercent,
    cv.brakepadwearpercent,
    (cv.tiremetrics->>'pressure_kpa')::int AS tire_pressure_kpa
FROM chassisandvehicle cv
LEFT JOIN engineandfluids ef ON cv.chassisengref = ef.engineregistry
WHERE 
    (1 - (cv.brakepadwearpercent + cv.trackwearpercent) / 200.0) * (cv.vehiclespeedkmh / 50.0) * (ef.engineloadpercent / 100.0) > 0.6
    AND cv.brakefluidlevelpercent > 50
